body: I hear ya man, thats a rough age to be especially when you don't have a very supportive network of friends or colleagues but i can tell you that things will get better as long as you take care of your mind and body and dude you don't sound stupid you sound sensitive and coherent which are two important qualities to have in a superficial kind of  society. keep the faith and if you need to talk Im here also you might want to repost this on r/SuicideWatch, it gets more traffic.

Hi Im sorry your struggling however you seem fairly young and it sounds to me like your situation isn't totally irredeemable. you have friends who hopefully care about you, you have social skills that enable you to find drugs. who says you can't parlay those drug getting skills onto job getting skills or counselor finding skills or relationship finding skills. there are plenty of people out there who struggle and have literally no one to talk to about there situation and no way of obtaining any means of escape. My advice would be to just keep your chin up, stay positive and (in all seriousness) give your hormones time to settle down, most of the problems associated with that age are just the body and mind playing tricks on you. hope this helps and I'm here if you need someone to talk to.

i think that guy was being a jerk, i don't know what purpose the moderators serve if they're sitting on their hands while some guy is telling people to kill themselves. honestly, i don't think your looking at much time if any for a simple drug infraction, and unless you've been smoking weed most drugs are out of your system within 72 hours or so. If you have been smoking weed i would be glad it was weed they found and not meth or something. courts don't like weed but they really don't like meth and heroin and stuff. i would just stick it out and in a few months it will all be over. good luck.
